rounds.survival_reason: The mutation reduces the grid x-dimension by 1, causing the last tile of output columns (up to 32 columns) to never be computed by any thread block. When the second kernel computes GroupNorm statistics and mean across all channels, it includes these garbage values, producing wildly incorrect results.
rounds.kill_strategy: Any input values will expose this bug because uninitialized memory will have arbitrary garbage values that differ significantly from correctly computed GELU outputs. The final output will be corrupted when GroupNorm averages over channels including the garbage columns.
rounds.recommendations: Always verify grid launch dimensions cover the full output tensor. Add assertions like `assert grid.x * TILE_SIZE >= N` in debug builds to catch launch configuration bugs early.
